messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — SI co-sell for Marketplace launch with NimbleHW goes live next Wed. We need a lean lead-handoff flow, clear account-mapping rules, and an escalation path for disputed ownership. Copying ops. Who can own initial intake (demo -> opp) and the 24h triage SLA?

Jon Rivera: I can own intake for enterprise accounts in NA. Clarify enterprise definition? ARR threshold or seat count?

Lee Patel: Proposal: ARR >= $100k OR seats >= 250 = enterprise. Territory mapping: if EMEA flag -> route to SI_EU queue. Otherwise NA/ROW to marketplace SDR unless tagged existing SI.

Alexei Novikov: Agree on thresholds. Add rules for co-sell credit: SI must be named on opportunity within 48h of intake or we mark as marketplace only. Also require a one-line intake note with "SI: <name>" and "Origin: Marketplace".

Maria Chen: Good call. Also vendors/hardware partners (NimbleHW) require marketing approvals for joint announcements — embargo + logos. Ops, please add an announcement gating step in the playbook.

Marketplace Ops Bot: Automatic mapping preview run: 5 candidate leads flagged for SI queue. Link: https://go.redwood/inventory/1725 (bot summary)

Jon Rivera: For disputed ownership: escalate to Partnerships triage channel within 6 hours. If still disputed at 24h, escalate to Dir Partnerships (Maria).

Lee Patel: Suggest adding an exclusion list: existing direct-sales owned accounts (tag: DS_OWNER) are not eligible for automated SI claim. Also prefer existing SI relationships — keep historical SI tag (si_partner_id) in account record.

Alexei Novikov: Also map hardware SKU-triggered routing: if lead requests Nimble A100-bundle -> auto-priority to Nimble SI queue. Helps ensure config/PO guidance aligns.

Maria Chen: Draft mapping snippet I want in playbook (feel free to refine):

```
# account_mapping rules
- if account.ARR >= 100000 OR account.seats >= 250 -> route = SI_Enterprise_Queue
- elif account.tags contains "existing_si" -> route = existing_si_owner_queue
- elif lead.requested_products contains "Nimble-A100" -> route = Nimble_SI_Queue, priority = high
- elif account.region == "EMEA" AND account.ARR >= 25000 -> route = SI_EU_Queue
- else -> route = Marketplace_SDR_Queue
- exclusions: if account.tags contains "DS_OWNER" -> route = Marketplace_SDR_Queue (no auto-claim)
```

Maria Chen: Action items — Jon: own NA enterprise intake + 24h triage SLA. Lee: update playbook mapping + exclusion list. Alexei: define co-sell ops steps for naming and credit (48h rule) and announcement gating. Ops Bot: wire the automation preview to send daily report.

Jon Rivera: On it. I'll set a daily 9am sweep for new intake. :thumbsup:

Lee Patel: I'll push a PR to the playbook doc and add the mapping snippet. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Alexei Novikov: Will write the co-sell naming template and the ops checklist for announcement gating. Ping me if we need legal approval flow.

Marketplace Ops Bot: Next mapping preview scheduled: 1725015900. Will post discrepancies and conflicts to #partnerships-triage.

Maria Chen: Perfect. One more thing — for joint announcement cadence with NimbleHW: target soft-announce two weeks after GA, formal press at month+1. Alexei, coordinate with Nimble's marketing for embargo dates.

Alexei Novikov: Will loop Nimble marketing and propose dates by EOD Friday.

Maria Chen: Thanks team — I'll update the roadmap ticket with these owners and close this sync. If anything urgent, escalate to #partnerships-triage.

Lee Patel: sgtm

Jon Rivera: thanks

Alexei Novikov: thanks everyone :rocket:
